name: Elegance and Insight Rubric v1
description: Evaluates math answers on whether they reveal WHY a result is true through a minimal, well-chosen idea. Scored via four sub-criteria averaged to produce a 0.0–1.0 score.

criteria.name: Conceptual Core
criteria.description: Does the answer identify a single unifying idea or structural observation that makes the result feel inevitable?
checks: Is there a named structural reason for why the result holds?
Is there a non-obvious reframing or connecting principle?
Or is the answer purely algorithmic/step-by-step without naming the underlying WHY?

criteria.name: Economy of Means
criteria.description: Does the answer reach its conclusion with minimal machinery?
checks: Could the key point be stated in 1-3 sentences?
Is the answer free of redundant steps?
Or is it a long sequence of symbol manipulations where a slicker path exists?

criteria.name: Explanatory Force
criteria.description: Does the answer explain WHY, not just WHAT or HOW?
checks: Would a reader understand the mechanism, not just verify the result?
Does the reader gain a transferable principle or perspective shift?
Or does the answer only demonstrate correct computation?

criteria.name: Avoidance of Brute Force
criteria.description: Does the answer deliberately avoid or criticize mechanical exhaustive approaches?
checks: Does the answer choose a principled path over a mechanical one?
Does it note why the elegant approach is preferred?
Or does it rely on case enumeration, computer assistance, or symbol-grinding when a conceptual shortcut is available?

scores.1.0: ALL four sub-criteria HIGH: compact, explanatory, avoids brute force, genuine aha
scores.0.75: THREE sub-criteria HIGH: strong insight but slightly mechanical in one dimension
scores.0.5: TWO sub-criteria HIGH: partial insight buried in computation or economical but shallow
scores.0.25: ONE sub-criterion HIGH: correct and clear but step-by-step mechanical
scores.0.0: NONE: brute-force computation, bare link/reference, or one-liner without reasoning
